# Setup -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman", repos = "https://cran.rstudio.com/")
}
pacman::p_load(tidyr, dplyr, ggplot2, lubridate, tibble, stringr,
               knitr, sf, giscoR, patchwork)
```

# Import ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false
load("../data/processed/model2_data.RData")
```

# Preprocess --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false

# Add log-transformed outcome and select snapshot months
Nuts3input <- model2_data %>%
  mutate(log_active_per_100k = log(active_per_100k))

Nuts3input_before <- Nuts3input %>%
  filter(month == "2022-03-01") %>%
  select(NUTS3, nuts3_name, lage_typ, month, active_per_100k, log_active_per_100k)

Nuts3input_after <- Nuts3input %>%
  filter(month == "2023-03-01") %>%
  select(NUTS3, nuts3_name, lage_typ, month, active_per_100k, log_active_per_100k)
```

# Map geometry ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

germany <- gisco_get_nuts(year = "2021", epsg = "4326", resolution = "20", nuts_level = 3)
de_map  <- subset(germany, CNTR_CODE == "DE")
```

# Categorize outcome ------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| echo: false

breaks <- c(0, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 42, Inf)
labels <- c("0-6", "7-12", "13-18", "19-24", "25-30", "31-36", "37-42", ">42")

de_map_before <- de_map %>%
  left_join(Nuts3input_before, by = c("NUTS_ID" = "NUTS3")) %>%
  mutate(active_cut = cut(active_per_100k, breaks = breaks, labels = labels,
                          include.lowest = TRUE))

de_map_after <- de_map %>%
  left_join(Nuts3input_after, by = c("NUTS_ID" = "NUTS3")) %>%
  mutate(active_cut = cut(active_per_100k, breaks = breaks, labels = labels,
                          include.lowest = TRUE))
```

# Figure: RPS diffusion map -----------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
#| label: fig-map
#| fig-cap: "**RPS partner availability across German NUTS-3 regions before and after mandate implementation.** a, Active RPS partners per 100,000 inhabitants in March 2022 (pre-mandate). b, Active RPS partners per 100,000 inhabitants in March 2023 (post-mandate). Darker shading indicates higher partner density; n = 394 NUTS-3 regions."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-dpi: 300
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

p1 <- ggplot(de_map_before) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = active_cut), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(
    name = "Active RPS partners per 100k inhabitants",
    palette = "Blues",
    direction = 1,
    na.value = "grey85",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(title = "2022") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14))

p2 <- ggplot(de_map_after) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = active_cut), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(
    name = "Active RPS partners per 100k inhabitants",
    palette = "Blues",
    direction = 1,
    na.value = "grey85",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(title = "2023") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14))

(p1 + p2 + plot_layout(guides = "collect")) &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```
